_comment: The only per-repo file in this skill. SKILL.md and repos.md are identical
across every repo that uses /ai-dev — when you copy the skill to another
project, edit this file and nothing else.
'toolkit' is the shared UI library this repo consumes from sources via a
relative path. Set it to null in a repo that has no such dependency.
runInstructions: DO NOT LAUNCH THE APP. This is the whole of the run instructions for now, and
the reasons are not negotiable:
· TreeFacts' vault root is hardcoded (NoteRepository.DEFAULT_DIRECTORY) to
/Users/soderbjorn/treefacts-db — the maintainer's REAL notes. There is no
environment variable or flag that points a run somewhere else. Any launch
loads those notes, and the 5-second autosave loop writes them back. A bug in
the ticket you are working on can therefore rewrite or delete real data.
· The Electron main process takes a single-instance lock. If the maintainer
has TreeFacts open, or another ticket launched it, your instance quits
immediately — or worse, you drive THEIR window and THEIR vault.
· The app runs only inside Electron (a plain browser run of :web fails with
`noteApi bridge unavailable`), and it opens a desktop window; there is no
headless mode.
So never run ./gradlew electron:run, scripts/run.sh, `electron .`, or the
/verify skill, and never touch scripts/wipe-vault.sh or scripts/seed-vault.py.
The port you are assigned is unused.
What you CAN verify:
· The configured build, which compiles every target and runs the tests.
· Unit tests in client/src/commonTest (SubtreeCodecTest, PromotionPolicyTest,
InlineMarkdownTokenizerTest, …). Everything below the View layer is
commonMain, so prefer adding a test that pins the ticket's behaviour — it
is the strongest verification this repo can offer. There is no fake
FileSystem in commonTest yet; if you need one for Document or
NoteRepository tests, add a small in-memory one there.
· For a rendering-only change, confirm the new code is in the bundle:
./gradlew :web:jsBrowserProductionWebpack, then grep the output for an
identifier you introduced.
State plainly in the PR's Verification section that the change was NOT
exercised in the running app, and list what a human should click through to
check it.
